review.note: Release 0.3.4 removes the forced Codex --ephemeral option so normal persistent CLI parent threads can create subagents. A bounded read-only A/B probe with Codex CLI 0.154.0, unchanged user configuration and no model override reproduced missing-thread spawn failure with --ephemeral and successful child spawn/wait without it; both canonical owners proved empty process trees, and all 10 externally sampled PIDs exited. Read-only sandbox, approval_policy=never, invocation-only notify=[], user model/authentication/tools/security hooks, full-review coverage and exact-candidate receipt validation remain unchanged. CLI rollout files are normally retained and are not deleted by the reviewer. Public toolkit arguments, snapshot schema/file closure and dependency bounds are unchanged; quality-first correction is compatible with existing consumers. Four actual source/snapshot and default/explicit-model argv regressions failed on the old implementation; all 208 reviewer tests and full fast checks passed after the repair. The live registry discovery exactly matches every Python and Node candidate in the previously reviewed 0.3.3 audit (SHA256 421d6200eb70e0a98d76e786b4164dceeecc9834267d8a0174e5674ad620428e): hatchling 1.32.4, packaging 26.3, build 1.6.1, mypy 2.4.0, pytest 9.1.1, pytest-xdist 3.8.0, Ruff 0.17.0 and markdownlint-cli2 0.23.3. The new worktree environment installed exactly these versions; all reported Python candidates support Python 3.14 and satisfy the existing bounds. The existing primary release-note compatibility conclusions remain applicable to the identical versions and unchanged constraints: https://hatch.pypa.io/dev/history/hatchling/ https://packaging.pypa.io/en/stable/changelog.html https://build.pypa.io/en/stable/changelog.html https://mypy.readthedocs.io/en/stable/changelog.html https://docs.pytest.org/en/stable/changelog.html https://pytest-xdist.readthedocs.io/en/latest/changelog.html https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff/releases/tag/0.17.0 https://github.com/DavidAnson/markdownlint-cli2/blob/v0.23.3/CHANGELOG.md . This regenerated receipt binds 0.3.4 and its dependency manifest. No pin, relaxed bound or compatibility fallback is introduced. Fresh artifact resolution, true repository review and the canonical full gate remain separate required evidence; no Windows online-review support or remote deployment is claimed.
